reason: Locked decision Q45 wired the §4 abuse tier into the rate limiter after finding it had no live caller. Future limiter work in Eventar must keep that wiring; the vault note still describes withSecurity as current practice, so the rules need a home in the skill library.

K3 added four facts the skill does not hold yet: the read opt-out, the sessionRevoked error contract, the door-page server check that ends a verified redirect loop, and a local backtest recipe for the tier.

The sign-in loop episode showed the cookie-trust redirect repeating on sibling pages, and the session check mis-treating a 429/network failure as a dead session. The skill states the rule for sign-in but not the sibling audit, the network/429 non-revoke rule, or the coverage gap that was found.

The door froze after a server-side revoke because proxy.ts redirects action POSTs for ended sessions, so action-level signed-out copy never shows. The skill documents the cookie-trust redirect but not this action-path failure, so the next client that calls a staff action would repeat the freeze.
